an11.17:1.1: Ekādasahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato gopālako abhabbo gogaṇaṃ pariharituṃ phātikātuṃ.
an11.17:1.3: Idha bhikkhave gopālako na rūpaññū hoti, na lakkhaṇakusalo hoti, na āsāṭikaṃ sāṭetā hoti, na vaṇaṃ paṭicchādetā hoti, na dhūmaṃ kattā hoti, na titthaṃ jānāti, na pītaṃ jānāti, na vīthiṃ jānāti, na gocarakusalo hoti, anavasesadohī hoti, ye te usabhā gopitaro goparināyakā, te na atirekapūjāya pūjetā hoti.
an11.17:1.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave ekādasahi aṅgehi samannāgato gopālako abhabbo gogaṇaṃ pariharituṃ phātikātuṃ. 3. Evam
an11.17:2.1: eva kho bhikkhave ekādasahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu abhabbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjituṃ.
an11.17:2.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu na rūpaññū hoti, na lakkhaṇakusalo hoti, na āsāṭikaṃ sāṭetā hoti, na vaṇaṃ paṭicchādetā hoti, na dhūmaṃ kattā hoti, na titthaṃ jānāti, na pītaṃ jānāti, na vīthiṃ jānāti, na gocarakusalo hoti, anavasesadohī hoti, ye te bhikkhū therā rattaññū cirapabbajitā saṅghapitaro saṅghaparināyakā, te na atirekapūjāya pūjetā hoti.
an11.17:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu na rūpaññū hoti? 5.
an11.17:3.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu yaṃ kiñci rūpaṃ ‘cattāri ca mahābhūtāni catunnañ ca mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya rūpan' ti yathābhūtaṃ na ppajānāti.
an11.17:3.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na rūpaññū hoti.
an11.17:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu na lakkhaṇakusalo hoti? 6.
an11.17:4.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu ‘kammalakkhaṇo bālo, kammalakkhaṇo paṇḍito' ti yathābhūtaṃ na ppajānāti.
an11.17:4.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na lakkhaṇakusalo hoti.
an11.17:5.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu na āsāṭikaṃ sāṭetā hoti? 7.
an11.17:5.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu uppannaṃ kāmavitakkaṃ adhivāseti na ppajahati na vinodeti na vyantīkaroti na anabhāvaṃ gameti, uppannaṃ vyāpādavitakkaṃ . . . uppannaṃ vihiṃsāvitakkaṃ . . .
an11.17:5.3: uppannuppanne pāpake akusale dhamme adhivāseti na ppajahati na vinodeti na vyantīkaroti na anabhāvaṃ gameti.
an11.17:5.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na āsāṭikaṃ sāṭetā hoti.
an11.17:6.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu na vaṇaṃ paṭicchādetā hoti? 8.
an11.17:6.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā nimittaggāhī hoti anuvyañjanaggāhī,
an11.17:6.3: yatvādhikaraṇam enaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya na ppaṭipajjati, na rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ, cakkhundriye na saṃvaraṃ āpajjati,
an11.17:6.8: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya nimittaggāhī hoti anuvyañjanaggāhī
an11.17:6.9: yatvādhikaraṇam enaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya na ppaṭipajjati, na rakkhati manindriyaṃ, manindriye na saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
an11.17:6.10: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na vaṇaṃ paṭicchādetā hoti.
an11.17:7.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu na dhūmaṃ kattā hoti? 9.
an11.17:7.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu na yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena paresaṃ desetā hoti.
an11.17:7.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na dhūmaṃ kattā hoti.
an11.17:8.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu na titthaṃ jānāti? 10.
an11.17:8.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu ye te bhikkhū bahussutā āgatāgamā dhammadharā vinayadharā mātikādharā, te kālena kālaṃ upasaṅkamitvā na paripucchati na paripañhati
an11.17:8.3: ‘idaṃ bhante kathaṃ, imassa ko attho' ti?
an11.17:8.4: Tassa te āyasmanto avivaṭañ c' eva na vivaranti, anuttānīkatañ ca na uttānīkaronti, anekavihitesu ca kaṅkhāṭhāniyesu dhammesu kaṅkhaṃ na ppaṭivinodenti.
an11.17:8.5: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na titthaṃ jānāti.
an11.17:9.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu na pītaṃ jānāti? 11.
an11.17:9.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye desiyamāne na labhati atthavedaṃ, na labhati dhammavedaṃ, na labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmujjaṃ.
an11.17:9.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na pītaṃ jānāti.
an11.17:10.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu na vīthiṃ jānāti? 12.
an11.17:10.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ yathābhūtaṃ na ppajānāti.
an11.17:10.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na vīthiṃ jānāti.
an11.17:11.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu na gocarakusalo hoti? 13.
an11.17:11.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu cattāro satipaṭṭhāne yathābhūtaṃ na ppajānāti.
an11.17:11.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na gocarakusalo hoti.
an11.17:12.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu anavasesadohī hoti? 14.
an11.17:12.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu saddhā gahapatikā abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavārenti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārena, tatra bhikkhu mattaṃ na jānāti paṭiggahaṇāya.
an11.17:12.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu anavasesadohī hoti.
an11.17:13.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu ye te bhikkhū therā rattaññū cirapabbajitā saṅghapitaro saṅghaparināyakā, te na atirekapūjāya pūjetā hoti? 15.
an11.17:13.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu ye te bhikkhū therā rattaññū cirapabbajitā saṅghapitaro saṅghaparināyakā, tesu na mettaṃ kāyakammaṃ paccupaṭṭhāpeti āvī c' eva raho ca, na mettaṃ vacīkammaṃ . . . na mettaṃ manokammaṃ paccupaṭṭhāpeti āvī c' eva raho ca.
an11.17:13.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ye te bhikkhū therā rattaññū cirapabbajitā saṅghapitaro saṅghaparināyakā, te na atirekapūjāya pūjetā hoti.
an11.17:14.1: Imehi kho bhikkhave ekādasahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu abhabbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjituṃ. 16.
an11.17:15.1: Ekādasahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato gopālako bhabbo gogaṇaṃ pariharituṃ phātikātuṃ.
an11.17:15.3: Idha bhikkhave gopālako rūpaññū hoti, lakkhaṇakusalo hoti, āsāṭikaṃ sāṭetā hoti, vaṇaṃ paṭicchādetā hoti, dhūmaṃ kattā hoti, titthaṃ jānāti, pītaṃ jānāti, vīthiṃ jānāti, gocarakusalo hoti, sāvasesadohī hoti, ye te usabhā gopitaro goparināyakā, te atīrekapūjāya pūjetā hoti.
an11.17:15.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave ekādasahi aṅgehi samannāgato gopālako bhabbo gogaṇaṃ pariharituṃ phātikātuṃ. 18. Evam
an11.17:16.1: eva kho bhikkhave ekādasahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu bhabbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuḍḍhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjituṃ.
an11.17:16.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu rūpaññū hoti, lakkhaṇakusalo hoti, āsāṭikaṃ sāṭetā hoti, vaṇaṃ paṭicchādetā hoti, dhūmaṃ kattā hoti, titthaṃ jānāti, pītaṃ jānāti, vīthiṃ jānāti, gocarakusalo hoti, sāvasesadohī hoti, ye te bhikkhū therā rattaññū cirapabbajitā saṅghapitaro saṅghaparināyakā, te atirekapūjāya pūjetā hoti.

an11.17:17.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu yaṃ kiñci rūpaṃ ‘cattāri ca mahābhūtāni catunnañ ca mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya rūpan' ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an11.17:17.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu rūpaññū hoti.

an11.17:18.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu lakkhaṇakusalo hoti.

an11.17:19.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu āsāṭikaṃ sāṭetā hoti.

an11.17:20.3: yatvādhikaraṇaṃ enaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ, cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati,
an11.17:20.8: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī hoti nānuvyañjanaggāhī
an11.17:20.9: yatvādhikaraṇam enaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati manindriyaṃ, manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
an11.17:20.10: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu vaṇaṃ paṭicchādetā hoti.

an11.17:21.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena paresaṃ desitā hoti.
an11.17:21.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu dhūmaṃ kattā hoti.

an11.17:22.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu ye te bhikkhū bahussutā āgatāgamā dhammadharā vinayadharā mātikādharā, te kālena kālaṃ upasaṅkamitvā paripucchati

an11.17:22.5: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu titthaṃ jānāti.

an11.17:24.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu vīthiṃ pajānāti.

an11.17:25.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu cattāro satipaṭṭhāne yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an11.17:25.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu gocarakusalo hoti.

an11.17:26.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu saddhā gahapatikā abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavārenti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārena,
an11.17:26.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sāvessadohī hoti.
